dashboardSource.organization: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of India

approval.rightsBasis: Official NDMA CapFeed page expressly invites applications/aggregators to consume RSS. C-DOT agency integration guide documents efficient feed consumption; official Vikaspedia National Disaster Alert Portal explains redistribution/broadcast by subscribed agencies. Scope: attributed unmodified RSS headline/summary/date/link, internal pending review; no website mirroring or CAP/image fetch.
approval.reviewedBy: Codex source-policy assessment under owner instruction, 18 November 2026
approval.approvalEvidence: Official CapFeed subscription instructions + Integration_Guide_For_Agencies.pdf; WMO register confirms this NDMA endpoint; official Vikaspedia permits subscribed agencies to disseminate alerts. Robots HTTP404 (not a denial); RFC9309 2.3.1.3 permits access in absence of robots, but explicit RSS service is the authorization basis. No credentials; no CAP document traversal. Evidence: other-official-source-policy.json, sachet-feed-test.json.
approval.testPlan: Two genuine worker collection runs; verify official asset IDs, publication dates, raw hashes, Notice-only classification and repeat idempotency. All records internal/review-pending; dated feed is not currentness approval.
